content:
{'text': '美國總統唐納德·特朗普週一在一個推廣女性健康的活動上離題，大談白宮裝修工程，藉機自我吹噓。', 'paragraph_context': 'President Donald Trump veered off topic at an event promoting women’s health on Monday, using a speech to toot his own horn over renovations at the White House.'}

{'text': '特朗普在簽署行政命令的儀式上感謝第一夫人梅拉尼婭·特朗普後獲得掌聲，他示意群眾在玫瑰園坐下，期間他去年安裝的白色石板露台似乎引起了他的注意。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump, who was met with applause after thanking first lady Melania Trump at the signing ceremony for an executive order, signaled for the crowd to take their seats in the Rose Garden before the white stone patio his administration installed last year appeared to catch his attention.'}

{'text': '「如果可以的話——那石頭真係好靚。」總統開始說道，他望着腳下的地面，展開了大約兩分鐘長嘅離題演說。', 'paragraph_context': '“If I might — that stone is so beautiful,” began the president, marveling at the ground before him toward the start of his roughly two-minute-long tangent.'}

{'text': '特朗普聲稱白宮建於濕地之上，因此玫瑰園嘅草地即使兩星期無落雨都會「濕透」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump claimed that the White House was built on a wetland and, thus, the grass in the Rose Garden would be “soaking” wet even if it didn’t rain for two weeks.'}

{'text': '「好多女士都整爛咗佢哋嘅鞋，佢哋望住我，已經整爛咗好多好多對鞋，因為我哋一直想用——用嗰個沼澤，但係唔得。」佢話。', 'paragraph_context': '“And many women have ruined their shoes, and they look at me, and they’ve ruined many, many sets of shoes as we kept trying to have — use that swamp and it didn’t work out,” he said.'}

{'text': '「我哋喺度做嘅嘢真係令人難以置信；呢度已經成為最熱門嘅舉辦記者會場地，希望你哋都鍾意。」', 'paragraph_context': '“And what we did here has just been incredible; it’s become the most popular place to have a news conference, and I hope you enjoy it.”'}

{'text': '佢隨後大肆讚賞露台座椅上「漂亮」嘅黃色四吋厚坐墊，話嗰啲坐墊係佢「特登訂造」嘅，而且比以前「舒服好多」。', 'paragraph_context': 'He then gushed about the “beautiful” yellow, 4-inch cushions on the patio seats, adding that he had them “specially made” and they’re “a lot more comfortable” than before.'}

{'text': '總統繼而指向白宮直升機停機坪，仲提到佢聲稱將會係「史上最偉大」嘅宴會廳暨軍用設施綜合建築，然後終於返到佢太太身上，�話係佢太太構思咗喺美國國家衛生研究院成立女性健康部門嘅構思。', 'paragraph_context': 'The president went on to point to the White House helipad and what he claimed would be the “greatest” ballroom-military complex “that’s ever been built” before finally circling back to his wife, whom he credited with conceiving the idea of a women’s health division at the National Institutes of Health.'}

{'text': '你可以喺下面睇到玫瑰園入面呢個古怪嘅時刻。', 'paragraph_context': 'You can watch the bizarre moment in the Rose Garden below.'}
